column1: # Slice resources (WORKFLOW.md §6). The coordinator appends a row on main with

# the slice is todo, doing or blocked in PLAN.md §0. Rows live as long as the plan: when the plan
# ends, the registry goes back to this header (slice IDs start again at S1 in the next plan).
